plan: This is a second-price auction, where bidding your true value is the dominant strategy regardless of what others do. If I win, I pay the second-highest bid, not my own bid, so there's no incentive to shade my bid down or up. Bidding exactly my value of $39 maximizes my expected profit: I win whenever my value exceeds the others' bids, and I pay less than my value, ensuring non-negative profit whenever I win.

Bidding higher risks overpaying relative to my value, while bidding lower risks losing profitable auctions. With my value at $27, I'll bid exactly that amount to ensure optimal outcomes.
